full_model.description: All mechanisms active: fast access, eligibility, replay, slow M_b write.

fast_context_only.description: Fast context gating active; M_b frozen at init (structural_lr=0, decay=0).

replay_no_structure.description: Replay updates transient E_b/P_b but cannot write M_b (structural_lr=0).

random_slow_drift.description: Slow Gaussian drift of matched scale (σ≈0.025/pass), non-specific branch targeting. Uses BASE_PARAMS for fast dynamics.

fixed_allocation_only.description: Overlap by construction; no dynamic E_b/P_b/M_b updating.
